# P8.1 Player frame

**Work package:** P8.1, the first of Phase 8. It needs Phase 7, which is done and was reviewed in session 56.

**Plan line:** menu (auto-generated from scenes and slides, editable titles, hide items, free / restricted / locked navigation), seekbar (with drag enable/disable), previous/next/submit, volume, captions toggle, playback speed, full screen, accessibility controls, course title, logo.

**What it is.** The course player already has:

- a bar with the course title;
- Previous, Next and a slide count;
- a CC button when the course has captions.

P8.1 makes that frame configurable per course and adds what the plan lists. How it looks (colours, fonts, layout, label words) is P8.3; P8.1 uses the current look.

**My design choices** (Luke said to continue), listed for him to change:

1. **One `project.player` record** holds every frame setting. A new course shows the menu, the seekbar (view only), volume, captions, speed, full screen and accessibility, with free navigation.
2. **Navigation limits apply to the menu only.**
   - **Free:** any entry can be chosen.
   - **Restricted:** only slides already visited, and the current one.
   - **Locked:** the menu shows where the learner is, but entries cannot be chosen.

   Next, Previous and triggers are unchanged: they are the author's own.

3. **The menu's entries:**
   - every scene, with its slides, in course order;
   - a draw slide is one entry, which goes to its first drawn question;
   - question-bank slides never appear;
   - an author's title replaces a slide's own;
   - a hidden entry is left out, but the slide still plays.
4. **The seekbar** shows the current slide's base-layer timeline: off, view only, or draggable.
5. **The player's Submit button** submits the current slide's question. It is shown only on question slides, when turned on (off by default: question slides have their own Submit).
6. **Volume and speed** are the learner's, for this session:
   - volume is a level from 0 to 1 that every sound and video plays at, times its own;
   - speed is 0.5×, 0.75×, 1×, 1.25×, 1.5× or 2×, and scales the course's clock and every media element's rate together.
7. **Accessibility controls** are a panel with:
   - caption size (normal, large, larger);
   - the course's keyboard shortcuts.

   Reduced motion stays the learner's system setting (session 45).

8. **The logo** is an image asset of the course, shown at the start of the bar.

## Saved format version 20

```ts
player: {
  title: boolean,
  logo: AssetHash | null,          // an image in project.assets
  menu: {
    show: boolean,
    navigation: 'free' | 'restricted' | 'locked',
    entries: Record<slideId, { title: string | null, hidden: boolean }>, // only what the author changed
  },
  controls: {
    seekbar: 'off' | 'view' | 'drag',
    submit: boolean,
    volume: boolean,
    captions: boolean,             // the CC button, when the course has captions
    speed: boolean,
    fullscreen: boolean,
    accessibility: boolean,
  },
}
```

- `entries` may name only scene slides, a draw slide among them.
- Deleting a slide drops its entry.
- The logo, if set, is an image asset.

**Migration 19 → 20:** the defaults above. Legacy fixture `v19-two-slides`.

## Runtime (player only)

**The frame** is built in a module of its own, `packages/player/src/frame.ts`, from `project.player`:

- **Bar:** the logo, then the course title, then the timer and review banner.
- **Footer:** Previous, Submit, the slide count, captions, volume, speed, accessibility, full screen, Next.
- **Menu:** a sidebar to the left of the stage, opened and closed with a Menu button.
  - It is a tree of scenes and slides; the current slide is marked (`aria-current`).
  - Entries the navigation does not allow are disabled.
- **Seekbar:** under the stage, from 0 to the base layer's length.
  - With `drag`, dragging it or using the arrow keys seeks (`engine.seek`).

**Speed:** the player keeps its own clock, advancing by real time × the speed, and gives that to the engine. The sound module sets each element's `playbackRate`.

**Full screen** is the root element's `requestFullscreen`, and the button reflects the state.

**Not saved:** volume, speed and caption size are the learner's, kept for the page only.

## Editor

**Design → Player…** opens the Player dialog:

- **Features:**
  - course title and logo (choose from the course's pictures, or none);
  - the controls;
  - the seekbar mode.
- **Menu:**
  - show it;
  - navigation;
  - every scene and slide, with a title field (blank for the slide's own) and a Hide checkbox.

All of it is one undo step per change (`project.setPlayer`).

## Done when

- **Model:**
  - `player` validates: entries name scene slides, and the logo is an image;
  - migration 19 → 20 and the fixture;
  - deleting a slide drops its entry;
  - `project.setPlayer` in the property test.
- **Player (unit, jsdom):**
  - the menu tree from scenes, with draw slides, author titles and hidden entries;
  - which entries each navigation allows;
  - the speed clock;
  - the volume level.
- **Player browser (Chromium and Firefox):**
  - the menu jumps, and is limited when restricted or locked;
  - the seekbar shows the time and, set to drag, seeks;
  - volume and speed reach a media element;
  - Submit submits;
  - full screen;
  - the accessibility panel changes the caption size;
  - controls turned off are absent;
  - title and logo.
- **e2e:**
  - in the Player dialog, rename and hide a menu entry, choose restricted navigation and a draggable seekbar, and turn speed off;
  - save and reopen;
  - publish, and see it in the course.
